thread:
zoe: Quick question: should SDKs attempt "soft-stickiness" to a preferred runtime based on routing hints, or always ask CP? Concern is extra latency for every request.

kevin: I think SDKs can use hint_ttl to do soft-stickiness, but must validate with token/lease when hint expired. We should document stale-hint behavior.

sasha: Agreed. Hints are advisory: SDKs may send traffic to preferred runtime + include x-routing-hint header. If they get 409/410, they should fall back to CP and fetch new hint.

maria: Also recommend SDK metrics: hint_hits, hint_misses, hint_staleness to help tune hint_ttl defaults per workload.

zoe: Makes sense. We'll add this to the SDK guidance doc.
